hero.title: Recyclables to rice and support a greener community
hero.subtext: Welcome to Rise to Rice, a community-driven initiative that transforms recyclable waste into a valuable resource to support sustainability and local communities. By repurposing waste, we reduce environmental impact and create opportunities for a greener future.

steps.title: Segregate
steps.description: Sort your recyclable waste properly by separating plastics, paper, metals, and other reusable materials.

steps.title: Exchange
steps.description: Bring your sorted recyclables to designated collection points. Each item you exchange is weighed and recorded.

steps.title: Redeem Rewards
steps.description: Earn points based on the weight and type of recyclables you submit. Accumulated points can be redeemed and exchanged for rice.

steps.title: Recycle
steps.description: Collected recyclables are processed and repurposed, reducing environmental impact.
